verdict.rationale: Poke is a messaging-based assistant, so letting it see and operate local applications is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only cloud app integrations via connectors and MCP. The MCP tunnel to a localhost server is a developer building block a user could use to build such tooling, not a computer-use capability Poke itself provides. Nothing documents Poke viewing the screen or controlling desktop applications.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
